interview.name: Quinn
interview.answer: It’s still undecided, and the first stop/location for the repair drive has not been set yet.

reflections: Quinn is the main organizer and information hub for the repair drive.
Opal is helping coordinate logistics, while Dane is willing to contribute even if he arrives late.
The group is collaborative and task-oriented, with Quinn delegating concrete follow-up work.
Quinn is the main organizer and coordinator, handling invitations and spreading updates to the group.
The others are contributing in practical, supportive ways by joining, listing needs, and watching for supplies.
The group’s tone is cooperative and task-focused, with Quinn acting as the central point of contact.
Quinn is the main coordinator, repeatedly collecting repair-drive details, invite lists, and missing-item information.
The others are responsive and cooperative, each contributing a small, concrete piece of help rather than driving the effort themselves.
The group is converging on a lightweight coordination flow: Quinn gathers and relays information, while participants send priorities or needed items as they learn them.
Quinn is the main coordinator, keeping an invite list and promising to share repair-drive details as they become available.
The others are responsive and cooperative, repeatedly confirming they will watch for updates and bring needed supplies or parts.
The group is still waiting on a first-stop decision, so the conversation is mostly about coordination and information passing rather than final plans.
Quinn is coordinating a repair drive and acting as the central point for invites and updates.
Oren, Vik, and Jules are supportive participants who offer to spread the word and relay missing details.
The group is waiting on two key unknowns: the first stop location and the specific repair needs/supplies.
